1	const mongoose = require('mongoose')
2	
3	const feeProfileSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
4	  {
5	    user: { type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: 'User', required: true },
6	    name: { type: String, required: true, trim: true },        // e.g. "IBI", "Meitav"
7	    type: { type: String, enum: ['percent', 'flat'], default: 'percent' },
8	    value: { type: Number, required: true, min: 0 },           // % or flat amount
9	    minFee: { type: Number, default: 0 },                      // minimum fee per trade
10	    currency: { type: String, default: 'USD' },                // currency for flat/min fee
11	    isDefault: { type: Boolean, default: false },
12	  },
13	  { timestamps: true }
14	)
15	
16	feeProfileSchema.index({ user: 1 })
17	
18	module.exports = mongoose.model('FeeProfile', feeProfileSchema)
19
